theorem mvcc.revBytes_le_iff (r e : mvcc.Rev) (t : Bool) : go.GoStringLe (mvcc.revBytes r false)
    (mvcc.revBytes e t) ↔ mvcc.revLeN r e

def mvcc.revNext (r : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.Rev :=
  { main := r.main, sub := r.sub + W64 1 }

theorem mvcc.LeaseZero.applyChange {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : mvcc.LeaseZero s) (r : w64) (c :
    mvcc.Change) (hc : ∀ (k v : GoString) (l : w64), c = mvcc.Change.put k v l → l = W64 0) :
    mvcc.LeaseZero (mvcc.applyChange r s c)

theorem mvcc.revCode_next (r : mvcc.Rev) (h : BitVec.toNat r.sub + 1 < 2 ^ 64) : mvcc.revCode
    (mvcc.revNext r) = mvcc.revCode r + 1

theorem mvcc.idxCRep_indexOf (log : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB log) : mvcc.IdxCRep (-1) (mvcc.evsOf
    log) (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf log))

theorem mvcc.logEnts_codes_sorted (log : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs :
    List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (lo hi : Nat) : List.Pairwise (fun e e' =>
    mvcc.revCode e.rev < mvcc.revCode e'.rev) (mvcc.logEnts log lo hi)

theorem mvcc.restoreLastRev_logEnts (R : mvcc.Log) (hR : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ R → cs ≠
    []) (hlen : List.length R + 2 < 2 ^ 63) : mvcc.restoreLastRev (mvcc.logEnts ([[], []] ++ R) 0
    ([[], []] ++ R).length) = W64 (↑([[], []] ++ R).length - 1)

def mvcc.revLeN (r e : mvcc.Rev) : Prop :=
  BitVec.toNat r.main < BitVec.toNat e.main ∨ r.main = e.main ∧ BitVec.toNat r.sub ≤ BitVec.toNat e.sub

def mvcc.revLeN_dec : DecidableRel mvcc.revLeN :=
  mvcc.revLeN_dec._aux_1 x✝¹ x✝

theorem mvcc.logEnts_restoreOk (log : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs :
    List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (h0 : List.getD log 0 [] = []) :
    mvcc.RestoreEntsOk (mvcc.logEnts log 0 (List.length log))

theorem mvcc.stateAt_leaseZero (log : mvcc.Log) (h : mvcc.LogNoLease log) (r : Nat) : mvcc.LeaseZero
    (mvcc.stateAt log r)

theorem mvcc.logEnts_length (log : mvcc.Log) : (mvcc.logEnts log 0 (List.length log)).length =
    mvcc.logCh log

def mvcc.entsFrom (log : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.Rev) : List mvcc.KvEnt :=
  List.filter (fun e => decide (mvcc.revLeN r e.rev)) (mvcc.logEnts log 0 (List.length log))

theorem mvcc.drop_eq_filter_gt {α : Type} (f : α → Nat) {l : List α} (hs : List.Pairwise (fun a b =>
    f a < f b) l) (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (e : α) (he : l[n - 1]? = some e) : List.drop n l =
    List.filter (fun x => decide (f e < f x)) l

theorem mvcc.logEnts_lease (log : mvcc.Log) (h : mvcc.LogNoLease log) (lo hi : Nat) (e : mvcc.KvEnt)
    : e ∈ mvcc.logEnts log lo hi → e.kv.lease = W64 0

theorem mvcc.entsFrom_next (log : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List
    mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (r : mvcc.Rev) (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (e :
    mvcc.KvEnt) (he : (mvcc.entsFrom log r)[n - 1]? = some e) : mvcc.entsFrom log (mvcc.revNext
    e.rev) = List.drop n (mvcc.entsFrom log r)

theorem mvcc.entsOfRev_length (r : Nat) (b : List EtcdKv) (hb : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess b) (cs :
    List mvcc.Change) : (mvcc.entsOfRev r b cs).length = cs.length

def mvcc.LeaseZero (s : List EtcdKv) : Prop :=
  ∀ (kv : EtcdKv), kv ∈ s → kv.lease = W64 0

theorem mvcc.sub_succ_nonneg (x : w64) (h : BitVec.toNat x < 2 ^ 63 - 1) : 0 ≤ sint.Z (x + W64 1)

theorem mvcc.logEnts_lt_max (log : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^ 63) (e : mvcc.KvEnt) (he
    : e ∈ mvcc.logEnts log 0 (List.length log)) : go.GoStringLt (mvcc.revBytes e.rev e.tomb)
    (mvcc.revBytes mvcc.revMax false)

theorem mvcc.revLeN_iff (r e : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.revLeN r e ↔ mvcc.revCode r ≤ mvcc.revCode e

theorem mvcc.idxCRep_indexOf_pend (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hb : mvcc.LogB (ilog
    ++ [pend])) (h : mvcc.IdxCRep (-1) (mvcc.evsOf ilog) (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf ilog))) :
    mvcc.IdxCRep (-1) (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])) (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])))

def mvcc.revCode (r : mvcc.Rev) : Nat :=
  BitVec.toNat r.main * 2 ^ 64 + BitVec.toNat r.sub

theorem mvcc.LeaseZero.applyChanges {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : mvcc.LeaseZero s) (r : w64) (cs : List
    mvcc.Change) (hc : ∀ (c : mvcc.Change), c ∈ cs → ∀ (k v : GoString) (l : w64), c =
    mvcc.Change.put k v l → l = W64 0) : mvcc.LeaseZero (mvcc.applyChanges r s cs)

def mvcc.revMax : mvcc.Rev :=
  { main := W64 (2 ^ 63 - 1), sub := W64 (2 ^ 63 - 1) }

def mvcc.LogNoLease (log : mvcc.Log) : Prop :=
  ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change),
    cs ∈ log → ∀ (c : mvcc.Change), c ∈ cs → ∀ (k v : GoString) (l : w64), c = mvcc.Change.put k v l → l = W64 0

theorem mvcc.bucketRange_from (log : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List
    mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (r : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.bucketRange (mvcc.bucketMap
    log) (mvcc.revBytes r false) (mvcc.revBytes mvcc.revMax false) = List.map mvcc.KvEnt.pair
    (mvcc.entsFrom log r)

theorem mvcc.entsOfRev_ne_nil (r : Nat) (b : List EtcdKv) (hb : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess b) (cs :
    List mvcc.Change) (hne : cs ≠ []) : mvcc.entsOfRev r b cs ≠ []

theorem mvcc.logEnts_sub_lt (log : mvcc.Log) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length
    < 2 ^ 63) (e : mvcc.KvEnt) (he : e ∈ mvcc.logEnts log 0 (List.length log)) : BitVec.toNat
    e.rev.sub + 1 < 2 ^ 64

theorem mvcc.stateAfter_leaseZero (log : mvcc.Log) (h : mvcc.LogNoLease log) : mvcc.LeaseZero
    (mvcc.stateAfter log)
